_note: Recomputed on the WS from the read-only copies (made 16 Oct 00:20-00:25 IST). Energy = trapezoid of the 200 ms board samples over [first mission start, last mission end], the rule of P1's run_one.energy_j.

gr_ss_n4.label: granite steady load 4 drones (running at copy)

T1_p1_baseline.definition: P1 Thor gemma-4-26B Reflexion, drones/edge_devices/final_sweep_thor/reflexion/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it, runs run_1..run_3 of each (task, instance). Pass = P1's grades.csv final_result (equals the harness final_result in all 63 runs). Energy = run_meta workflow_energy_J (board energy over the run).

P3c_loop_detector.population: the 6 Thor runs (W1 n4/n8, step-wise final n4/n8, step-wise fast-sim n4/n8)
P3c_loop_detector.note: her detector's exact rule is not in the data copy; these are my rules (a W-character block of the model's reasoning/answer/tool-call text appearing for the k-th time; trigger position converted from characters to tokens by the call's tokens-per-character ratio)

P1c_next_call_time.definition: gap = (send time of the next LLM call) - (end time of the call that issued the move); move = step_fly_to/step_fly_body with distance > 0.5 m (distance from the transcript states); calls separated by an evaluator call are excluded. Prediction = 10.6 s + distance / 2 m/s. NB the 10 s is the hover the P5 tool server itself adds after every move (P5_INSPECT_S=10, stepwise_mcp_server.py line 45) and 2 m/s is the simulator's flight speed.

P2c_conversation_growth.definition: growth = prompt_tokens of the next step call - prompt_tokens of this step call (same attempt, no evaluator call in between)

P4c_retry_rescue.definition: rescue = mission whose PASSED line is True and whose last [SUPERVISOR] attempt number is >= 2

O3_reread.definition: server-side time-to-first-token (ttft_s, recorded only when one request finished its first token in the sampling window) of calls whose uncached prompt (prompt_tokens - cached_tokens) is large; queue empty during the call (so no queueing is counted).
